name: Zaizen Takashi
source:
He is a corporate executive from a family of celebrities for generations.

He has been divorced more than three times, has children all over the place, and is currently a single, flamboyant man.

He has many mistresses, but he is interested in Rina, who is a rarity in his surroundings: a common, pretty, and innocent-looking woman.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/ntr_mansion/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
